description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Assistant Director of Nursing (ADON) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Mediapolis, IA. This is an excellent opportunity for a nursing leader to contribute to high-quality patient care and support our clinical team.

In this vital role, you will assist the Director of Nursing in overseeing daily nursing operations, ensuring compliance with all regulatory standards, and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff. We are looking for a candidate who is passionate about making a difference in the lives of our residents and is ready to take on a challenging yet rewarding position. The annual salary for this position ranges from $60,000 to $75,000, with Registered Nurse (RN) licensure preferred.
requirements: Previous experience in a skilled nursing facility or long-term care setting
Strong clinical assessment and critical thinking abilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $60,000 - $75,000, based on experience and qualifications.

description: We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) to lead operations at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Baltimore County, MD. This is a confidential opportunity for a visionary leader passionate about delivering exceptional patient care and fostering a positive environment for both residents and staff.In this pivotal full-time role, you will oversee all aspects of facility management, ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and driving continuous improvement in quality of care and operational efficiency. We are looking for a leader who can inspire teams, manage resources effectively, and uphold the highest standards of service.This position offers a competitive salary ranging from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, reflecting your expertise and commitment. Join a facility dedicated to making a significant impact in the lives of its residents.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Licensed Nursing Home Administrator (LNHA) license in Maryland.
Proven experience in a leadership role within a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility.
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations governing long-term care.
Demonstrated ability to manage operations, staff, and resident care effectively.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation ranges from $115,000 to $145,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Registered Nurse (RN) to join a premier health and rehabilitation center as an MDS Coordinator in Missouri Valley, IA. This full-time position offers a vital opportunity to contribute to comprehensive resident care through accurate assessment and care planning.

As an MDS Coordinator, you will play a crucial role in ensuring compliance with regulatory standards and optimizing resident outcomes. We are looking for a committed professional who is not seeking an interim role, but rather a long-term opportunity to make a significant impact within our compassionate team. This role offers an annual salary between $65,000 and $75,000, reflecting your expertise and dedication.
requirements: Proven experience as an MDS Coordinator, with strong knowledge of MDS 3.0.
Demonstrated ability in resident assessment, care planning, and regulatory compliance.
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or long-term care environment.
Must be seeking a permanent, full-time position (no interim candidates).
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary ranging from $65,000 to $75,000, based on experience.
